headline: Gold Prices Drop 8.6% in Azerbaijan Over Five Trading Days
summary: The price of one troy ounce of gold in Azerbaijan fell by 566.83 manat ($333.43), or 8.6%, between November 16 and November 20.
why: Domestic precious metal benchmark prices in Azerbaijan mirror physical bullion demand and international gold spot fluctuations.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: International spot gold sell-off triggered an 8.6% domestic price drop in Azerbaijan.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Global precious metal selling pressure dragged down domestic price benchmarks.
